sanity_check.description: Recomputed published macro success from frozen public trajectories and re-verified every controller transition with NanoJev own verifier (summarize_sonic_supervision.verify_episode).

frozen_cohort_548.description: NanoJev frozen 548-case cohort (274 test + 274 OOD), greedy controller epsilon 0.1 seed 17. vcdm row is our own rollout (compare_v1_frozen_episodes.jsonl, 28140 transitions verified); nanojev/jev/native_qwen rows are the frozen published trajectories.

nanojev_rerun_fidelity.description: Our re-execution of the public NanoJev weights (sha256 f68c47d6...) through our harness. Not bit-exact: torch 2.10 lacks torch._native.triton_utils (their runs used --disable-native-triton) and batching differs; closed-loop chaos amplifies bf16-level score drift.

reverse_systemone_test.description: NanoJev public weights on our probability-mechanism test split (8145 rows), choice->choice / noul->boolean adapter.

p2_mixed_domain.description: VCDM v2: one Qwen3-0.6B scoring-head model trained 2000 steps on 1:1 mix of systemone probability tasks and NanoJev soft game decisions, from scratch.

latency_bench.single_scope: tokenize + forward + group softmax, one question at a time, warm

nanojev_a100_reference.scope: 8 states, 24 questions, 68 candidate paths, <=85 tokens, warm forward only
